newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Airways drops cargo carrier venture - sources.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways drops cargo carrier venture - sources.

text.p: Thai Airways International Plc has pulled out of a proposed joint venture to set up a new air cargo carrier after its workers launched a two-day strike against the idea, airline sources said on Friday.
The airline workers strike ended late on Tuesday after seriously affecting cargo movement from Bangkok international airport.

Thai Airways sources told Reuters the national carrier had told its private partners in the proposed Thai Air Cargo Ltd that the airline was not ready to go ahead with its earlier plan to hold a 40 percent stake in the venture.
The cabinet had approved the venture last month.
Thai Airways declined to comment on the issue.
The airline's workers had protested because they feared the new firm would cost them their jobs.

They claimed the government decision was not transparent and was linked to interests of some political parties in the administration of Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa, who has called elections for November 17.
